name: ProductHunter
tagline: Morning and evening digest of what just launched on Product Hunt and HN
description: It sweeps Product Hunt and Hacker News for things that have just shipped, tops that up with finds from X, YouTube and Kickstarter, and sends one roundup in the morning and another in the evening. Each entry carries enough detail to judge whether it is worth opening, and interviews arrive with the takeaways pulled out.
author: Davidwuuu92
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
